chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn, from Ali ibn al-Nu'man, from Suwayd al-Qalanisi, from Bashir, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him). He said:

I said to him, 'I saw in a dream that I said to you: Verily, fighting alongside someone other than the Imam whose obedience is obligatory is forbidden, like carrion, blood, and the flesh of swine.' So you said to me: 'Yes, it is like that.' Then Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) said: 'It is like that! It is like that!'

key_terms.الدَّمِ: Blood (flowing blood, which is prohibited in Islamic dietary law)
key_terms.الْإِمَامِ الْمُفْتَرَضِ طَاعَتُهُ: The Imam whose obedience is obligatory — the divinely-designated Imam from the Ahl al-Bayt
key_terms.الْمَيْتَةِ: Carrion, meat from an animal that died without proper slaughter

ai.seo_question: Is fighting in jihad without the command of the legitimate Imam forbidden in Shia Islam?
ai.summary: In this hadith, Bashir recounts to Imam al-Sadiq (AS) a dream in which he had conveyed to the Imam that fighting under the command of someone other than the divinely-appointed Imam — whose obedience is made obligatory by God — is as forbidden as consuming carrion, blood, and swine flesh. The Imam confirms this ruling emphatically, repeating 'It is like that!' twice, emphasizing the absolute prohibition. This narration situates the issue of armed jihad within the framework of Imamate: legitimate fighting requires the command of a legitimate Imam, and fighting without such authority is categorically haram, using the same prohibitions mentioned in the Quran for unlawful food.

en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Muhammad Bin Al Husayn, from Ali Bin Al No’man, from Suweyd Al Qalanasy, from basher, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>, said, ‘I said to him<sup>asws</sup>, ‘I saw in the dream that I said to you<sup>asws</sup> that the fighting along with other than the Imam<sup>asws</sup> the obedience to whom is Obligatory, is Prohibited, like the (consumption of) the dead, and the blood, and the flesh of the swine. So you<sup>asws</sup> said to me: ‘It is like that’. So Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘It is like that! It is like that!’
en.sarwar: 2. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn, from Ali ibn al-Nu’man from Suwayd al-Qalanisiy from Bashir who has said the following:

“I once said to abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, ‘I saw a dream in which I said to you, “Fighting alongside an Imam to whom obedience is not obligatory is unlawful like consuming dead animals, blood and pork for food”, and you said to me, “Yes, that is how it is.’” Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al- Salam, then said, ‘That is how it is. That is how it is.’”
